description.narrative: A Breakthrough-ACTION utilizará ferramentas de última geração baseadas em evidências para encorajar as pessoas nos países em desenvolvimento a adoptarem comportamentos saudáveis, desde a utilização de métodos contraceptivos modernos, passando por dormir debaixo de redes mosquiteiras até ao teste de VIH. Grande parte do trabalho aproveitará o poder da comunicação - desde campanhas nos meios de comunicação social, passando por dramas televisivos e radiofónicos, até simples cartazes numa clínica de saúde - para inspirar mudanças duradouras. O projeto também aproveitará outras abordagens da ciência comportamental, como a economia comportamental e o design centrado no ser humano, para melhorar os programas. Espera-se que o programa – que se baseia num projecto anterior de cinco anos e 31 países, denominado Health Communication Capacity Collaborative (HC3) – tenha o dobro da dimensão. Será liderado pelo CCP, que fará parceria com Save the Children, ideas42, ThinkPlace Kenya e Camber Collective. Breakthrough-ACTION também será apoiado no terreno pela ActionSprout, o Centro Internacional de Investigação sobre Mulheres e Rede Humana Internacional. O CCP está sediado na Escola de Saúde Pública Johns Hopkins Bloomberg.

Breakthrough-ACTION utilisera des outils de pointe fondés sur des données probantes pour encourager les habitants des pays en développement à adopter des comportements sains, allant de l'utilisation de méthodes contraceptives modernes au sommeil sous des moustiquaires en passant par le dépistage du VIH. Une grande partie du travail exploitera le pouvoir de la communication – des campagnes médiatiques aux séries télévisées et radiophoniques en passant par les simples affiches dans une clinique de santé – pour inspirer un changement durable. Le projet tirera également parti d'autres approches des sciences du comportement, telles que l'économie comportementale et la conception centrée sur l'humain, pour améliorer les programmes. Le programme – qui s’appuie sur un projet antérieur de cinq ans portant sur 31 pays appelé Health Communication Capacity Collaborative (HC3) – devrait doubler de taille. Il sera dirigé par CCP qui s'associera à Save the Children, ideas42, ThinkPlace Kenya et Camber Collective. Breakthrough-ACTION sera également soutenu sur le terrain par ActionSprout, le Centre international de recherche sur les femmes et Human Network International. Le CCP est basé à la Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health.

Breakthrough-ACTION utilizará herramientas de última generación basadas en evidencia para alentar a las personas de los países en desarrollo a adoptar comportamientos saludables, desde el uso de métodos anticonceptivos modernos hasta dormir bajo mosquiteros y hacerse la prueba del VIH. Gran parte del trabajo aprovechará el poder de la comunicación (desde campañas en los medios de comunicación hasta dramas de radio y televisión y simples carteles en una clínica de salud) para inspirar un cambio duradero. El proyecto también aprovechará otros enfoques de las ciencias del comportamiento, como la economía del comportamiento y el diseño centrado en el ser humano, para mejorar los programas. Se espera que el programa, que se basa en un proyecto anterior de cinco años de duración en 31 países llamado Health Communication Capacity Collaborative (HC3), duplique su tamaño. Estará dirigido por CCP, que se asociará con Save the Children, ideas42, ThinkPlace Kenya y Camber Collective. Breakthrough-ACTION también contará con el apoyo en el campo de ActionSprout, el Centro Internacional de Investigación sobre Mujeres y Human Network International. CCP tiene su sede en la Escuela de Salud Pública Bloomberg de Johns Hopkins.

Breakthrough-ACTION will use state-of-the-art, evidence-based tools to encourage people in developing countries to adopt healthy behaviors, from using modern contraceptive methods to sleeping under bed nets to being tested for HIV. Much of the work will harness the power of communication - from mass media campaigns to TV and radio dramas to simple posters in a health clinic - to inspire long-lasting change. The project will also take advantage of other behavioral science approaches such as behavioral economics and human-centered design to improve programs. The program - which builds on a prior five-year, 31-country project called the Health Communication Capacity Collaborative (HC3) - is expected to be double the size. It will be led by CCP who will partner with Save the Children, ideas42, ThinkPlace Kenya and Camber Collective. Breakthrough-ACTION will also be supported in the field by ActionSprout, the International Center for Research on Women and Human Network International. CCP is based at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health.

L'activité principale du programme de partenariat pour les services publics de l'énergie est l'établissement de partenariats exécutifs individuels entre les services publics d'électricité des pays en développement, les services publics de gaz, les opérateurs de transport et d'autres opérateurs et décideurs politiques du secteur énergétique et leurs homologues américains.

Objectives for Nepal: 1. Assess and strengthen SBCC systems within the GON’s health system: Breakthrough ACTION Nepal works with the National Health Education Information Communication Center to analyze the current state of Nepal’s SBCC system. Using a participatory SBCC capacity mapping exercise at the federal and local levels, the activity will assess existing competencies, review guidelines and SBCC materials and design action plans to strengthen the SBCC system. It will also pilot a SBCC package in four municipalities. The lessons learned from this process will be shared to inform future SBCC capacity strengthening activities in the newly federalized health system. 2. Strengthen the GON’s use of high-quality data to inform program decisions at all levels. Breakthrough ACTION Nepal works with the National Health Education Information Communication Center to identify priority issues and analyze existing data from the government and partners to fill gaps in knowledge and inform SBCC activities for reproductive, maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health and nutrition. The activity will ensure that the data is user-friendly and easily accessible for critical decision-makers at appropriate levels. 3. Assess and strengthen coordination of the “SBCC system” among institutions, organizations and individuals practicing SBCC. Breakthrough ACTION Nepal will engage with SBCC stakeholders to refine and advance SBCC in Nepal. The activity will bring SBCC health partners and stakeholders together to map the relationships, responsibilities and resources in the newly federalized health system. This group will harmonize messages and approaches, strengthen SBCC coordination, and offer opportunities for participants to exchange lessons learned and advance high-quality SBCC programming through periodic ‘deep dives’ into key SBCC skills, such as audience segmentation, monitoring or new behavioral insights.
